title: The Man Who Leaped for Joy
reflectionQuestion: The man who had never walked jumped up and went leaping and praising God. I wonder what makes you so happy that you want to jump and leap for joy?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (lame man healed at the Beautiful Gate, Acts 3:1-10). Register=LEAPING/AMAZEMENT (bright batch). Feeling-first open (the man who couldn't walk). Subtraction: years of not-walking framed gently in one line. One image: the man leaping into the temple holding Peter & John. Ends on the leap + crowd's wonder, no moral coda. 'God' in prose. Voice VOICE_BARNABAS_ENCOURAGER (uplifting joy).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
